pairs.subject: self-healing
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/IncidentDetailModal.tsx:74 The inbox shows a green 'Auto-fixed' badge whenever an applied-fix string is present, and the AuditIncident shape it renders has no outcome field, so the surface operators read cannot tell confirmed-fixed from reverted or unknown.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/IncidentDetailModal.tsx:77 The 'Auto-fixed' label is based only on autoFixApplied being present. The rendered record has no confirmed, reverted or unknown outcome, which is the applied-equals-fixed inflation the technique names. The same pattern is at IncidentRow.tsx:48-51.

src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/useAuditIncidents.ts:21 The inbox only displays mock incidents that were already promoted. Promotion, triggers and signature dedup happen upstream, outside this context.

src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/IncidentDetailModal.tsx:97 The view renders the category computed upstream; it does no signature extraction or diagnosis of its own. It also shows no diagnosis-vs-guess marker, but that field does not exist in the source shape.
src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/IncidentDetailModal.tsx:119 A recommendation string is displayed; no strategy is selected or run here.

src/components/dashboard/views/incidents/incidents-page/IncidentsKpiHeader.tsx:44 The view computes only display counts; it applies no change and watches no error rate, so there is nothing to roll back.

pairs.registryProposal: The standard says 'healing is visible' and wants an operator to be able to answer 'did it help?', but no technique covers the read-only surface that renders healer records. A short rule is worth adding: a display that receives an applied-fix record without an outcome must say 'applied', not 'fixed'.
